d: India's very own home-grown bullet train is now one step closer to reality. Indian Union Minister of Railways, Ashwini Vaishnaw has shared footage of India's B28 bullet train being built at a BEML (Bharat Earth Movers Limited) facility in Bengaluru in Karnataka. The B28 or Bharat 28 or the Vande Bullet will not just be India's first bullet train, but also South Asia's first bullet train, and also the fastest.
